description: Frozen outcomes for the DEL-12-02 value-record sweep (value_record_sweep.json), one per case in sweep order, 100 to a line, comma-separated; the outcome code is the spec's. The *_before columns were captured from the real code at e430375d28 (Python core/security/redaction/route_control.py; TypeScript redactionExportControls.ts). The Rust mirror then had no route projector, so its column holds '-' (not mirrored) for every case, which the tests skip. `contract` is the outcome all three give under the value-record rule (HELP_HUMAN decision 2026-10-28: "take the stricter decision per case"); each implementation's test asserts it case for case, and that no case is less strict than either decided before column. A case is less strict when it does not block where the column blocked, or when any member both cover takes a lower code in the order I < W < R < O.
